question: Which of the remaining A1 identifiability gates are ready, satisfied, or still require a run?
verdict: NOT ADMISSIBLE — 1 SATISFIED, 8 CONTRACT-BUILT BUT UNRUN, 0 UNSATISFIABLE
reading: C6 is satisfied by the committed C6-TIMING-1 block. The other eight gates have executable contracts and synthetic controls; C1/C4/C7 thresholds and the C8 ceiling are precommitted. Each open gate has one attempt and a terminal failure disposition: a failed or unmeasurable gate is UNSATISFIABLE for A1 and requires a new design, not another instrumentation round. None can be cleared from the observational records because each needs an A-, K-, Y- or A-K- cell that has not run. The design remains not admissible and no causal model is read.

conditions.status: CONTRACT BUILT; THRESHOLD PRECOMMITTED, NOT RUN
conditions.current_evidence: A0 supports the parallel-path premise: 26/26 rows form a carrier with zero direct service, and admission leaves the carrier intact. No A- or K- arm has been executed, so cross-path separation has not been observed. Threshold: at least 95% preservation of the other path, per seed.
conditions.contract: gate_c1(rows, tolerance): among paired-control available edges, A- keeps K and K- keeps A at or above the tolerance on every seed.
conditions.remaining: Implement A-/K- and run the arms; the threshold is already fixed.

conditions.current_evidence: No A-, K- or Y- execution exists; the A0 records are observational joins.
conditions.contract: gate_c2(rows): A- drives A to zero, K- drives K to zero, Y- drives Y to zero while the other path stays above zero.
conditions.remaining: Run each manipulation and verify its named path moved.

conditions.current_evidence: The A0 slice contributes only A-K+ (26 rows); A+K+, A+K- and A-K- have no denominators, and the Y- cells do not exist.
conditions.contract: gate_c3(rows): every eligible edge has all four A x K cells and every seed has both Y- cells.
conditions.remaining: Join every eligible edge to both factors and observe all six cells.

conditions.status: CONTRACT BUILT; THRESHOLD PRECOMMITTED, NOT RUN
conditions.current_evidence: No edge-level intervention was run, so there is no neighbour delta to compare. Threshold: absolute A/K/Y delta no greater than 0.05 on non-target edges.
conditions.contract: gate_c4(rows, tolerance): every non-target edge's A, K and Y neighbour delta stays within tolerance.
conditions.remaining: Implement the edge-level arms and measure spillover; the threshold is already fixed.

conditions.current_evidence: Direct and reverse counts exist for all 26 A0 rows; an edge-level strength field is present on 0 rows, and U is not joined to all four cells or either Y- cell.
conditions.contract: gate_c5(rows): direct count, reverse count and strength are present and measured before the carrier, K and Y on every row.
conditions.remaining: Measure edge strength for every eligible edge and join U to all cells before the outcome.

conditions.current_evidence: C6-TIMING-1 returned `C6 ORDER VARIATION CONFIRMED` on six fresh seeds; N1-N7 pass.
conditions.contract: The C6 block's N1-N7 and per-order floors are the gate.

conditions.status: CONTRACT BUILT; THRESHOLD PRECOMMITTED, NOT RUN
conditions.current_evidence: No Y- assertion blockade exists; A and K have not been held fixed under Y-. Threshold: absolute A/K formation delta no greater than 0.05.
conditions.contract: gate_c7(rows, tolerance): Y- lowers assertion while A and K formation stay within tolerance.
conditions.remaining: Implement Y- and run it at A+K+ and A-K+; the threshold is already fixed.

conditions.status: CONTRACT BUILT; CEILING PRECOMMITTED, NOT RUN
conditions.current_evidence: No A-K- double block exists. The T8 ceiling is precommitted at 0.05, so a double-block assertion rate above 5% would read THIRD ROUTE PRESENT.
conditions.contract: gate_c8(rows, ceiling): A-K- assertion is at or below the precommitted ceiling.
conditions.remaining: Implement the double block and run it; the ceiling is already fixed.

conditions.current_evidence: A0 fixes six committed seeds, 120 cycles and cap 40; the design fixes A+K+, A+K-, A-K+, A-K- and Y- at A+K+/A-K+, but no cell exists to pair.
conditions.contract: gate_c9(rows): every cell of a seed carries one world/cycles/cap/candidate-universe/U fingerprint.
conditions.remaining: Run the paired cells and refuse any cell whose object fingerprint differs.

bounds.rule: One implementation and one registered run per gate. A failed or unmeasurable gate is UNSATISFIABLE for A1 and terminal: no A1 patch, threshold change, extra cell or rerun. A new registered design is required to try again.

C1_path_separation.attempt: Implement A- and K- once and run the registered 2x2 cells.
C1_path_separation.success: The C1 contract passes on every seed.
C1_path_separation.on_failure: NOT IDENTIFIED: the two-path model is not testable.
C1_path_separation.on_unmeasurable: UNSATISFIABLE: no paired-control denominator after one attempt.

C2_treatment_consistency.attempt: Run each manipulation once and read its named path.
C2_treatment_consistency.success: The C2 contract passes on every seed.
C2_treatment_consistency.on_failure: VOID: the intervention did not happen as specified.
C2_treatment_consistency.on_unmeasurable: UNSATISFIABLE: a required manipulation has no denominator.

C3_positivity.attempt: Join every eligible edge to both factors once and read all six cells.
C3_positivity.success: The C3 contract passes on every seed and edge.
C3_positivity.on_failure: VOID: a required cell is empty.
C3_positivity.on_unmeasurable: UNSATISFIABLE: no eligible edge can populate the cells.

C4_no_interference.attempt: Freeze the targets, grant the run, and measure non-target spillover once.
C4_no_interference.success: The C4 contract passes on every non-target edge.
C4_no_interference.on_failure: VOID: a non-target A, K or Y delta exceeds 0.05; the A1 run is invalid.
C4_no_interference.on_unmeasurable: UNSATISFIABLE: no non-target edge has a measurable delta.

C5_common_cause.attempt: Measure edge strength and join pre-outcome U to every cell once.
C5_common_cause.success: The C5 contract passes on every row.
C5_common_cause.on_failure: SHARED CAUSE / NO CARRIER RELATION NOT SEPARATED.
C5_common_cause.on_unmeasurable: UNSATISFIABLE: U has no pre-outcome measurement on a required row.

C7_assertion_block.attempt: Implement Y- once and read assertion and A/K formation at A+K+ and A-K+.
C7_assertion_block.success: The C7 contract passes at both Y- cells.
C7_assertion_block.on_unmeasurable: UNSATISFIABLE: no Y- cell has a paired control.

C8_third_route.attempt: Implement the A-K- double block once and read assertion.
C8_third_route.success: A-K- assertion is at or below the precommitted 0.05 ceiling.
C8_third_route.on_failure: THIRD ROUTE PRESENT: the two-path model is incomplete.

C9_same_object.attempt: Run the paired cells once and compare their object fingerprints.
C9_same_object.success: The C9 contract passes for every seed.
C9_same_object.on_failure: VOID: the comparison is not paired.
C9_same_object.on_unmeasurable: UNSATISFIABLE: a paired cell has no object fingerprint.

C4_no_interference.void_condition: Any measurable non-target A, K or Y neighbour delta above 0.05, or an unmeasurable non-target stream, makes the A1 run VOID.
C4_no_interference.freeze_effect: C4 is not a pre-freeze blocker. The targets remain draft and the manifest remains unfrozen because no separate owner freeze act exists.

C1_path_separation.note: C1 is scored in the same post-freeze assembly and uses the C4 denominator.

not_evidence: A gate-contract audit on committed records. It runs no cell, assigns no seed and establishes no causal, capability or transfer claim.
